title: Project National Integration - JK Update
summary: Modern dental facility inaugurated at SDH Langate, equipped with two high-tech dental chairs and supporting equipment, benefiting over 10 lakh people in Langate and adjoining areas.
description:
Modern dental facility inaugurated at SDH Langate, equipped with two high-tech dental chairs and supporting equipment, benefiting over 10 lakh people in Langate and adjoining areas. The facility was established with Rotary Club Mumbai’s support under CSR, with Army Camp Langate facilitating the project.
